◇ FAQ

Everything worth asking

Our questionnaire captures the eight variables that genuinely change the cost: property type, bathrooms, current system, flue position and so on. That is enough to give a price we will stand behind. If your home turns out to be genuinely unusual, we tell you before starting and you are free to walk away.

Across most of our coverage area, yes. Accept before 3pm and next-day slots are usually available. Cylinder and full-system jobs need two to three days so the right parts are on the van.

Boiler, flue, magnetic filter, system cleanse, all labour, Building Control notification, Gas Safe certification, warranty registration and removal of the old unit. VAT is already included in the number you see.

As a rule: one bathroom and a combi will serve you well; two or more in simultaneous use and a system boiler with a cylinder holds up far better. Our questionnaire recommends one and an engineer confirms it before installation day.

Rarely. A powerflush and a magnetic filter resolve most older systems. If a radiator or run of pipe genuinely needs replacing we show you why and price it separately, and you decide whether it happens.

Yes. Interest-free over 24 months, or longer terms at a fixed representative rate. Both are subject to status, and the monthly figure appears beside every package before you commit.

Something not covered? Call 01632 960 300, and an engineer answers, not a script.
